name: Liebe ~Omoide no Okurimono~
original_name: リーベ ～想い出の贈り物～
source:
Main character has girls phobia because of traumatic past with his former girlfriend. One day he is caught in thoughts and gets to a traffic incident. When he wakes up, there's a girl Aya before him who claims that his life expectancy is just one week. In order to change his fate he must overcome his phobia of women and have a love affair...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公过去曾被前女友伤害，因此患上女性恐惧症。一天，他沉浸在思绪中时遭遇交通事故。醒来后，一名叫彩的少女出现在面前，声称他的寿命只剩一周。为了改变命运，他必须克服对女性的恐惧，并谈一场恋爱…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
